notes:
Inbound from content marketing vertical — demo requested after whitepaper CTA. Primary ask: scale templates and batch generate large sets of SEO articles (daily jobs ~10k+ completions).
- Source: inbound MQL via webinar 'Scaling Content Ops' (2026-02-20).
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable cost per article and low tail latency for short templates."
- Prefers open/quantized models to control cost; willing to test Redwood hosted if unit economics beat current provider.
- Interested in batching and prefix/KV caching to amortize prompt overhead across thousands of similar templates.
- No immediate enterprise compliance requirement beyond SOC2; will accept public-cloud SaaS.
- Wants a short POC: 72h run, measure tokens per article, avg latency, cost per 1k completions, cache hit rate.
- Pricing deck sent (drive link). Security questionnaire partially answered; SOC2 attestation requested.
- AE notes: good fit for Hosted API self-serve -> convert by showing 30-40% cost saving with batching+cache.
- Typical content length: 200-800 tokens; many repeated prefixes (title, brand boilerplate).
- Rate expectations: sustained bursts, ~800-1200 reqs/sec for 5-10 minute windows; typical steady-state 50-200 reqs/sec.
- Engineering concerns: tokenization differences across models, sample quality for SEO, deterministic output for templates.

requirements_summary: Workload: high-volume templated article generation + social posts. Latency target: median <200ms for template fills; tail <1s on bursts. Throughput: ability to handle brief bursts of ~1k rps. Cost sensitivity: priority #1 — goal to reduce per-article cost by 30% vs current provider. Model preferences: open weights preferred, support for quantized runtimes and smaller model variants acceptable if quality is preserved. Routing/fallback: single-region public cloud is fine, automatic fallback to cheaper model variant acceptable under quality guardrails. Observability: token-level cost and per-route latency analytics required. Security: SOC2 attestation and audit logs. POC success metrics: cost per 1k completions, avg latency, cache hit rate, quality sample pass rate >= 90%.
proposal_highlights: Offer: Hosted API sandbox, recommended config: batching enabled (adaptive), prefix KV caching for templates, suggest model family X (quantized). Estimated cost scenario modeled in deck. 72h POC to gather real metrics. Can enable rate limits and burst quotas in account. No dedicated/private ask at this stage.
sales_playbook_notes: SMB inbound -> self-serve funnel. Emphasize quick wins: pre-built batching presets, demo showing 10k template run, clear cost calculator. Provide example prompt templates and caching best practices. If POC shows 25-30% savings, propose monthly usage plan + committed credits.
